title: A wizard puts on a hat from its backpack, its paper doll and a second client show it, it is still worn after a relog, and it goes back to the backpack
notes: Two Fire wizards enter the Commons on accounts of their own. The main wizard backs away from the Start and opens its backpack, whose
paper doll wears the hat the wizard was made with; the companion arrives and turns to face it. '.additem 1446127' gives the main wizard
WC1-Hat-Tier1, the Dramaturgist's Hat, which a level 1 wizard may wear. Double-clicking its row sends MSG_EQUIPITEM with the slot Hat;
the server stores it in character_equipment, answers MSG_EQUIPMENTBEHAVIOR_EQUIPITEM and relays MSG_EQUIPMENTBEHAVIOR_PUBLICEQUIPITEM,
so the paper doll and the companion's view of the main wizard's head both change.
The main client is quit and started again: the hat is still in its slot row, the doll still wears it, and the companion sees the main wizard
come back in it, from the m_publicItemList sent with the wizard. Double-clicking the worn row takes the hat off into the backpack,

and the row, the wearer's own view and the companion's view go back; the doll is not judged then, since it shows the row the backpack has chosen. The regions compared are the doll's head on the backpack's left page and the main wizard's
head where the companion's turn leaves it on its screen. The hue of what the hat changed on the doll, in the wearer's own view and on the
companion's screen must agree, and neither client may log that it found no texture for a worn item, which is what a public entry that is
not a WizardEquippedItemInfo makes it say before it draws the hat in its fallback texture.
